## Install

Download `306Tube-{{VERSION}}.apk` below and open it. Android 8.0+ on arm64 or 32-bit ARM.

Updating from an older release keeps your data. If Android says the package conflicts with an existing one, you have a build signed with a different key: uninstall that first.

## About

306Tube is a YouTube client for Android. No ads, no Google Play Services, works signed out. Background play, downloads, SponsorBlock, DeArrow, Return YouTube Dislike and casting are built in. Full rundown in the [README](https://github.com/306bobby-android/306tube#readme).

Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
